ui.the_recording_could_not_be_played: The recording could not be played.
ui.the_waveform_is_ready_and_you_can_alr: The waveform is ready and you can already listen to the concert. Analysis finds the tracks and takes about one minute per half-hour of recording.
ui.sections_to_remove_cannot_be_named: Sections to remove cannot be named
ui.remove_the_end_boundary_and_merge: Remove the end boundary and merge
ui.add_a_boundary_at_the_playhead_c: Add a boundary at the playhead (C)
ui.the_detailed_waveform_could_not_be_lo: The detailed waveform could not be loaded.
ui.the_end_of_the_concert_cannot_be_merg: The end of the concert cannot be merged.
ui.automatically_split_a_recorded_concer: Automatically split a recorded concert into tracks, removing gaps and applause.
ui.video_requires_ffmpeg_a_tool_supplied: Video requires ffmpeg, a tool supplied separately from ConcertCutter. It takes around 110 MB, so you only need to download it if you want video output. The button installs it once for future exports.
ui.one_mp4_of_the_entire_concert: One MP4 of the entire concert
ui.one_image_per_track_is_selected_but_t: “One image per track” is selected, but there are fewer images than tracks. After the last image, export starts again with the first. Images repeat until the end of the concert.
ui.this_folder_already_contains_an_expor: This folder already contains an export.
ui.deselecting_a_track_changes_neither_t: Deselecting a track changes neither the edits nor the numbering: track 7 will still be “07” even when exported alone. To remove a passage from the concert itself, use the editing card.
ui.a_single_wav_containing_the_tracks_ba: A single WAV containing the tracks back to back, with gaps removed. A cue sheet in “infos” lets you navigate between tracks during playback or when burning a disc.
ui.numbered_and_named_using_the_title_yo: Numbered and named using the title you entered. Suitable for a music player or USB drive.
ui.the_end_of_each_track_fades_into_the: The end of each track fades into the start of the next. At zero, tracks play back to back, as on a disc. This setting applies only to the output above it: the full-concert WAV and MP4 each have their own crossfade, while individual track files have no transitions to make.
ui.uses_the_background_image_the_display: Uses the background image. The displayed title follows the current track instead of staying the same throughout the concert.
ui.includes_the_track_title_overlaid_on_: Includes the track title overlaid on the image. Suitable for platforms that only accept video.
ui.the_concert_gets_its_own_folder_here_: The concert gets its own folder here, named after the recording. An existing export is never overwritten without your request.
ui.select_at_least_one_track_to_export: Select at least one track to export.
ui.select_at_least_one_output_file: Select at least one output file.
ui.choose_at_least_one_video_background_: Choose at least one video background image.
ui.export_stopped_the_previous_export_wa: Export stopped. The previous export was preserved.
ui.track_1_gets_the_first_image_track_2: Track 1 gets the first image, track 2 the second, and so on; the cycle repeats if there are fewer images than tracks. In the full-concert video, the background changes with each track; individual track videos keep a single image. When unchecked, images advance on a timer in both outputs.
ui.duration_of_the_transition_between_im: Duration of the transition between images. With one image per track, transitions occur at track boundaries in the full-concert video. Individual track videos have just one image, so there is no transition.
ui.images_play_in_the_order_above_changi: Images play in the order above, changing every eight seconds and repeating for as long as the audio lasts. Each image keeps its aspect ratio and is centered on black.
ui.concert_photos_cover_art_or_a_poster_: Concert photos, cover art or a poster. The track title is overlaid on top.
ui.open_another_recording_or_resume_a_pr: Open another recording or resume a project
ui.export_the_concert_and_its_tracks: Export the concert and its tracks
ui.rules_used_when_analyzing_the_concert: Rules used when analyzing the concert. Run analysis again after changing these values.
ui.trimming_and_fade_rules_applied_when_: Trimming and fade rules applied when generating export files.
ui.shorter_silences_are_treated_as_pause: Shorter silences are treated as pauses within a track, rather than sections to remove.
ui.shorter_passages_are_not_counted_as_t: Shorter passages are not counted as tracks. Seventy-five seconds excludes announcements while keeping short encores.
ui.if_you_know_how_many_tracks_the_conce: If you know how many tracks the concert contains, detection uses that number. Zero lets it decide.
ui.audio_kept_before_the_track_starts_it: Audio kept before the track starts. It extends into the preceding removed section to compensate for detection delay without keeping extra applause.
ui.audio_kept_after_the_track_ends_the_l: Audio kept after the track ends: the lingering note and the start of the applause.
ui.very_short_inaudible_fades_prevent_cl: Very short, inaudible fades prevent clicks caused by cutting directly through a waveform.
ui.click_to_move_the_detail_view: Click to move the detail view
ui.automatically_detected_sections_remov: Automatically detected sections removed from the export
ui.automatically_detected_gap_or_applaus: Automatically detected gap or applause: this passage will not be exported.
ui.keep_this_passage_in_the_export_inste: Keep this passage in the export instead of removing it
ui.loop_the_segment_under_the_playhead_b: Loop the segment under the playhead (B)
